title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: invoice deadline, booking status and payment due date
content:
## Scope

This policy of the AHL Demurrage and Detention Free Time category governs when the final demurrage and detention invoice of a per-container record may still be issued, on which records invoice lines may be booked, when the invoice falls due and when the record is settled.

## Invoice deadline

1. The invoice must be issued no later than the product's invoice issue deadline in calendar days after the charges stopped accruing.
2. The deadline is the clock-stop date of the record plus the product's deadline days, counted on calendar dates, and an invoice dated on the deadline itself is in time.
3. A record whose deadline has passed without an invoice is settled without one, because the charges are no longer collectible.

The clock starts from the record's clock-stop date as the line's records show it, and the comparison is made before the invoice is booked.

## Status required for booking invoice lines

4. Invoice lines may be booked only on a record whose status is clock stopped or invoiced.

## Due date and settlement

5. The invoice is due the product's payment term in calendar days after its date, or after the customer's credit days when the customer is credit-approved and the credit days are longer.
6. A record whose invoice has been fully paid, waived or credited is settled.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical; an illustrative deadline of 10 days is used only to show the counting)

| Clock-stop date | Deadline under the illustrative 10 days | Invoice dated | In time? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 June | 15 June | 14 June | yes |
| 5 June | 15 June | 15 June | yes, the deadline day itself is in time |
| 5 June | 15 June | 16 June | no; the record is settled without an invoice |

## Status path of a stopped record

| From | To | When |
|---|---|---|
| clock stopped | invoiced | the final demurrage and detention invoice is issued |
| clock stopped | settled | nothing is invoiced, because no day was chargeable, the total is below the minimum invoice, or the invoice deadline passed |
| invoiced | settled | the balance due has reached 0.00 through payments, waivers and dispute credits |

## Points of judgement

**Q: A customer's credit days are shorter than the product's payment term. Which applies?**
A: The product's payment term; the credit days replace it only when the customer is credit-approved and the credit days are longer.

**Q: Can an invoice line be booked while the record still shows charges accruing?**
A: No. Invoice lines may be booked only when the record is clock stopped or already invoiced.
